findings.message: Removing the deferred resp.Body.Close() means the response body is never closed on early returns: if os.Create fails or io.Copy returns an error, Fetch returns without closing resp.Body, leaking the connection and preventing HTTP keep-alive reuse.
findings.suggestion: Restore `defer resp.Body.Close()` immediately after the Get succeeds (and drop the manual Close call), so all return paths close the body exactly once.
